description: The status readout's model picker stays put while a conversation opens: the table of contents button that shows beside it once the messages are in must not push it aside. The screen is 1280x800. An init script records, every animation frame, the x position of ".model-picker-inline" (rounded to 0.1px, only while it has a width) in the array window.__triggerXs whenever it differs from the last one recorded. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The button named exactly "Conversation table of contents" should be visible (allow 30s). 3. Eval new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => r('done')))) with expect "done". 4. Eval window.__triggerXs.length with expect "1": the picker has had one position since it first showed.
